claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified on the current record if the certification packet and current model card are updated to reflect the current evaluation batch and explicitly disclose the student aid advising regression as a material limitation for a named launch use case.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring may supply context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
A conditional path to compliance is not the same as evidence that compliance has already been achieved.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card showing the current evaluation batch results are recorded.
Provide the exact disclosure text identifying the student aid advising regression as a material limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation if the team intends to rely on mitigation instead of disclosure.
Provide the certification packet version intended for launch so the policy-required linkage between evidence and release documentation can be verified.
specific_concerns: The policy predicate for certification is not yet satisfied in the admissible record because there is no evidence that the current release documentation already reflects the new evaluation results and subgroup regression.
The student aid advising weakness appears material for a named launch use case, but the record contains no attached disclosure language and no approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
The Actor's packet moves from a supported conditional reading of policy to a recommendation to certify, even though the required documentation step is only proposed, not evidenced.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are correctly treated as context, but they do not cure the missing current-release documentation requirement.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently defensible on the existing record, rather than only potentially defensible after the required disclosure is actually added to the release documentation.

That public governance guidance materially supports the certification decision beyond the internal policy requirements; the public guidance is general and does not establish satisfaction of the release-policy predicate.
That the subgroup weakness has in fact been identified in the current packet/model card as a material limitation for the named launch use case.
